rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when turning to a person for advice or help.

example.english: When I have a problem with the lease, I turn to Ming for help.
example.traditional: 有租約問題，我就搵阿明幫手。
example.jyutping: jau5 zou1 joek3 man6 tai4 ngo5 zau6 wan2 aa3 ming4 bong1 sau2

rows.note: Use this when changing the activity or direction of your efforts, such as turning to making films.

example.english: Running a restaurant became too hard, so they decided to turn to making films.
example.traditional: 做餐飲做唔掂，佢哋決定轉去拍戲。
example.jyutping: zou6 caan1 jam2 zou6 m4 dim6 keoi5 dei6 kyut3 ding6 zyun2 heoi3 paak3 hei3

rows.note: Use this when resorting to a person, resource, or method to get through a difficult situation.

example.english: The project nearly collapsed, so we had to turn to the boss for a loan.
example.traditional: 今次工程差啲爛尾，我哋唯有靠老闆借錢頂住。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 gung1 cing4 caa1 di1 laan6 mei5 ngo5 dei6 wai4 jau5 kaau3 lou5 baan2 ze3 cin2 ding2 zyu6
